text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to buy some high-protein snacks
for catering during team training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to find it anywhere,
I was clutching my head in frustration when...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
What is a grown adult doing standing frozen
in the middle of the shopping street?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hesitatingly, I explained the situation, and then—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...So you want a reasonably priced, readily available,
individually portioned, high-protein snack?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, roasted soybean flour is rich in protein. Size-wise, it's also perfect for catering.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit far, but there's a privately owned
shop if you turn right at the third intersection from here.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
They sell kinako candy sticks there in large bags containing individual portions.
The price is quite reasonable, too.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, kinako absorbs moisture from your mouth,
so having water ready is essential. Please be careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It gets resolved in no time, leaving me thoroughly impressed.
choice_data_list: Coming up with that so quickly is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's an old habit of mine to memorize shops
and places whenever I come across them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, her usual dignified expression vanished, replaced by a strangely clouded look—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "...It was a favorite of an Umamusume I used to train."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could stop her, she had already walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The profile of Acting Director Kashimoto as she walked away
lingered in my mind for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At any rate, the kinako sticks were surprisingly
popular, turning out to be a great refreshment treat.
